_doc: Your preferences. Everything here is display or policy — nothing changes what is collected. Safe to commit; it contains no identity and no secrets.
_timezone_doc: Fixed UTC offset in hours used for every date, hour, and session boundary in the digest. Raw events on disk stay in UTC; only the presentation tier shifts. Defaults to +8 (SGT/CST/WITA/HKT/MYT/PHT) because that is where most of this project's users are. Jakarta/Bangkok/Hanoi = 7, India = 5.5, Japan/Korea = 9.
_currency_doc: Display currency for every cost figure. USD keeps the raw estimate. Anything else converts via plans.json -> currencies.
_plan_doc: What you actually pay each month, if anything. Set this and the dashboard stops pretending your token estimate is a bill and starts telling you what your plan returned. Ids come from plans.json. Use "none" for metered API.
_community_doc: The opt-in community layer. Nothing is uploaded while `share` is false, which is the default — see docs/specs/Community-Share-Protocol.md for exactly what a share payload contains, and docs/adr/ADR-012-Opt-In-By-Default-Off.md for why the default is off rather than on.
